record.field:
Routes a call into a Dograh voice-agent workflow run.
Answers, attaches mod_audio_fork (bidirectional raw L16 PCM at 16 kHz) to the workflow run's media WebSocket returned by Dograh's inbound webhook, optionally starts the standard recording webhook, and parks the call. mod_audio_fork metadata stays an empty {} on purpose: the module's argument parser splits on whitespace (ADR-038, ADR-035).
Variables: agent_id - connect.dograh.agent record ID number - Extension number (regex-escaped) ws_url - Media WebSocket URL from Dograh (contains run identity) run_id - Dograh workflow run ID (exported for CDR correlation) record_calls - Whether to record the session recording_url - Recording webhook base URL (empty disables recording)

<extension name="dograh_agent_{{ agent_id }}"> <condition field="destination_number" expression="^{{ number }}$"> <action application="answer"/> <action application="sleep" data="500"/> <action application="export" data="odoo_dograh_agent_id={{ agent_id }}"/> <action application="export" data="odoo_dograh_run_id={{ run_id }}"/> <action application="set" data="api_result=${uuid_audio_fork(${uuid} start {{ ws_url }} mono 16k dograh {} true true 16000)}"/> {% if record_calls and recording_url %} <action application="set" data="RECORD_STEREO=true"/> <action application="set" data="media_bug_answer_req=true"/> <action application="record_session" data="{{ recording_url }}/${uuid}.wav"/> {% endif %} <action application="park"/> </condition> </extension>

<extension name="dograh_agent_{{ agent_id }}"> <condition field="destination_number" expression="^{{ number }}$"> <action application="answer"/> <action application="sleep" data="500"/> <action application="export" data="odoo_dograh_agent_id={{ agent_id }}"/> <action application="export" data="odoo_dograh_run_id={{ run_id }}"/> <action application="set" data="api_result=${uuid_audio_fork(${uuid} start {{ ws_url }} mono 16k dograh {} true true 16000)}"/> {% if record_calls and recording_url %} <action application="set" data="RECORD_STEREO=true"/> <action application="set" data="media_bug_answer_req=true"/> <action application="record_session" data="{{ recording_url }}/${uuid}.wav"/> {% endif %} <action application="park"/> </condition> </extension>

Landing extension for Dograh-initiated outbound calls.
connect.settings.dograh_originate dials the destination through an outgoing route and hunts the answered leg here. The media WebSocket URL rides in the dograh_ws_url channel variable set at originate time, so this template needs no render variables.

<extension name="dograh_outbound"> <condition field="destination_number" expression=".*"> <action application="answer"/> <action application="set" data="api_result=${uuid_audio_fork(${uuid} start ${dograh_ws_url} mono 16k dograh {} true true 16000)}"/> <action application="park"/> </condition> </extension>

<extension name="dograh_outbound"> <condition field="destination_number" expression=".*"> <action application="answer"/> <action application="set" data="api_result=${uuid_audio_fork(${uuid} start ${dograh_ws_url} mono 16k dograh {} true true 16000)}"/> <action application="park"/> </condition> </extension>
